2608.06752.title: Mind the Gap: A Dual Knowledge Graph Framework for Unified Multi-task User Intent Inference
2608.06752.paper_summary: This paper proposes DKG-MTI, a dual knowledge graph framework for unified multi-task user intent inference from online travel reviews. Existing approaches often rely on hierarchical pipelines that suffer from error propagation or retrieval methods that ignore structural relationships in domain knowledge. To address these limitations, we introduce an inference-only knowledge augmentation framework that dynamically constructs a User-Specific Intent Knowledge Graph from each review and aligns it with a Global Hotel Knowledge Graph through structure-aware semantic smoothing. The aligned knowledge is combined with the original review and processed by a large language model to simultaneously predict aspect ratings and generate reverse user intent statements. Experiments on TripAdvisor reviews show that DKG-MTI consistently outperforms strong LLM and retrieval-based baselines in both classification and intent generation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of structure-aware knowledge alignment for scalable and explainable intent inference.
2608.06752.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了DKG-MTI，一個雙重知識圖譜框架，用於從線上旅遊評論中統一多任務的用戶意圖推斷。<lb/>現有的方法通常依賴於層級管道，這些管道容易受到錯誤傳播的影響，或者使用忽略領域知識中結構關係的檢索方法。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們引入了一個僅用於推斷的知識增強框架，該框架從每條評論動態構建用戶特定意圖知識圖譜，並通過結構感知的語義平滑將其與全球酒店知識圖譜對齊。<lb/>對齊的知識與原始評論結合，並由大型語言模型處理，以同時預測方面評分並生成反向用戶意圖陳述。<lb/>在TripAdvisor評論上的實驗顯示，DKG-MTI在分類和意圖生成任務中始終超越強大的LLM和基於檢索的基準，證明了結構感知知識對於可擴展和可解釋的意圖推斷的有效性。
